skills.label: Grill me
skills.role: Adversarial interview skill that stress-tests assumptions, edge cases, and design choices before writing any code.
skills.trigger: Ambiguous prompts, greenfield architecture, or underspecified feature requests.
skills.audit: Did the agent challenge assumptions and ask targeted architectural/edge-case questions before proposing code?
skills.install_note: Clone to a staging folder, inspect upstream instructions and actual skill paths, then install with the host-supported installer. Clone alone does not activate a skill.

skills.label: read first
skills.role: Codifies the "read before write" rule, forcing agents to inspect existing files, conventions, and dependencies prior to modifying code.
skills.trigger: Any task touching an existing repository or file.
skills.audit: Were file-read/search tools executed on target files and dependencies *before* any plan or edit was emitted?
skills.install_note: Clone to a staging folder, inspect upstream instructions and actual skill paths, then install with the host-supported installer. Clone alone does not activate a skill.

skills.label: plan, no code
skills.role: Enforces an explicit planning gate where the agent outputs a step-by-step implementation plan without writing executable code until approved.
skills.trigger: Multi-file changes, refactors, or new feature designs prior to user sign-off.
skills.audit: Did the output contain a structured step-by-step plan and ZERO executable implementation code blocks?
skills.install_note: BLOCKED: Flashmind is not an owner/repository identifier. Ask for the canonical URL; do not invent a command.

skills.label: smallest version
skills.role: Enforces minimal vertical slices and rejects speculative abstractions, premature generalization, or unrequested configurability.
skills.trigger: Feature scoping, MVP builds, or prompts prone to over-engineering.
skills.audit: Were speculative abstractions stripped out in favor of the smallest working vertical slice?
skills.install_note: Clone to a staging folder, inspect upstream instructions and actual skill paths, then install with the host-supported installer. Clone alone does not activate a skill.

skills.label: one step
skills.role: Restricts the agent to executing one task item per prompt, verifying test output before advancing to the next step.
skills.trigger: Approved multi-step implementation plans.
skills.audit: Did the agent execute strictly ONE plan item and verify its result before stopping?
skills.install_note: BLOCKED: Flashmind is not an owner/repository identifier. Ask for the canonical URL; do not invent a command.

skills.label: stay in scope
skills.role: Prevents unsolicited refactoring, drive-by formatting, or touching files outside the explicit task boundary.
skills.trigger: All code modification and feature implementation turns.
skills.audit: Were 100% of modified lines directly required by the prompt, with zero drive-by formatting or unrelated file edits?

skills.label: what changed

skills.trigger: Every turn that mutates files.
